# gfm

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-001 — Bare URLs become safe links](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-001.md) — When a writer types a bare http(s) or www URL in prose, the Studio SHALL show it as a working link, leaving code, existing links and unsafe schemes as plain text.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-002 — GitHub Flavored Markdown renders as on GitHub, safely](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-002.md) — When a document uses bare http(s) or www URLs, GitHub alerts, strikethrough, footnotes, pipe tables or the small raw HTML subset of collapsible details, keyboard keys, HTML tables and coloured spans, the Studio SHALL show them as GitHub would, in both LF and CRLF files, and drop unsafe HTML, unsafe colours and unsafe link schemes.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-003 — A writer toggles task checkboxes from the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-003.md) — When a writer clicks a checkbox in the preview, the Studio SHALL change only that checkbox in the source as one undoable step, or refuse with a reason when the preview is stale or read-only.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-004 — Small raw HTML subset renders safely](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-GFM-004.md) — When a document uses collapsible details, keyboard keys, HTML tables or coloured spans, the Studio SHALL show them while dropping unsafe HTML and unsafe colours.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
